reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount that every amount site already calls, and takes the tolerance from the rules module's getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once inside getScheduledAmount; no site re-derives it.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts; call sites in loot-core and desktop-client only pass their op.

scope.why: The edits are the helper, the call sites that must now state their op, the forecast type field and tests.

maintainability.why: Making op a required argument forces every caller to choose explicitly (display sites pass null), so no path can silently skip the rule.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount; all 14 callers (preview, post, updateActions, forecast, template, API, Balance, schedule lists, edit hook) pass op explicitly.
